headnotes.la: …t salutis causa in incarnatione Jesu Christi Domini nostri consistit, quia non est aliud nomen super terram datum hominibus, testante Petro apostolo, in quo oporteat salvos fieri, de quo et Paulus ait
headnotes.en: … in the incarnation of Jesus Christ our Lord, since there is no other name given to men upon the earth — Peter the apostle bearing witness — in which it behooves us to be saved; of whom Paul also says

headnotes.la: Et item
headnotes.en: And again

headnotes.la: De quo rursum ait
headnotes.en: Of whom again he says

headnotes.la: … eo, sciens quia ipse potens est liberare et defendere eos qui in ejus protectione veraciter confidunt, et ob hoc non timet adversarium, quia nocere illi non potest, nisi permissus. Unde Psalmista ait
headnotes.en: …himself is able to deliver and defend those who truly trust in his protection; and on this account he does not fear the adversary, because he cannot harm him unless permitted. Whence the Psalmist says

headnotes.la: Non potest impulsus cadere, cui auxilium Domini videtur fortitudo praestare; sed ne putaretur sola pericula declinare quem Domini dona servabant, adjecit,
headnotes.en: He who is struck cannot fall, to whom the help of the Lord is seen to furnish strength; but lest he whom the Lord's gifts preserved should be thought only to escape dangers, he added,

headnotes.la: Quem supra Emmanuel, et Accelera spolia detrahere, Festina praedari, et reliquis appellaret nominibus, ne videretur alter esse praeter eum quem Gabriel Virgini nuntiavit dicens
headnotes.en: … had called Emmanuel, and Hasten to take away the spoils, Make speed to take prey, and by the remaining names, lest he should seem to be another beside him whom Gabriel announced to the Virgin, saying

headnotes.la: …endas, nequaquam de aquis fluminis Aegypti, quae percussae sunt, neque de aquis fluminis Rasni, sed de fontibus Jesu. Hoc enim Hebraeorum lingua Salvator exprimitur. Unde et ipse clamabat in Evangelio
headnotes.en: …hich were smitten, nor from the waters of the river of Rasni, but from the fountains of Jesus. For in the tongue of the Hebrews this expresses "Saviour." Whence he himself also cried out in the Gospel

headnotes.la: inquit Evangelista,
headnotes.en: says the Evangelist,

headnotes.la: Et in alio ipse loquitur Evangelio
headnotes.en: And in another Gospel he himself speaks

headnotes.la: Fontes Salvatoris doctrinam intelligamus evangelicam, de qua in septuagesimo septimo psalmo legimus
headnotes.en: Let us understand the fountains of the Saviour to be the evangelical doctrine, of which we read in the seventy-seventh psalm

headnotes.la: …ael his, qui de gentibus crediderunt, ut soli confiteantur Domino et, idolis derelictis, invocent nomen ejus, et cuncta ejus opera praedicent infidelibus, ut sciant quoniam ipse solus excelsus est, et
headnotes.en: … Gentiles: that they should confess to the Lord alone and, with idols forsaken, call upon his name, and proclaim all his works to the unbelieving, that they may know that he alone is exalted, and that

headnotes.la: cui cantandum est, quod magnifice fecerit, et in omni orbe illius misericordia praedicetur. Huic etiam loco concordat initium centesimi quarti psalmi, ubi ita scriptum est,
headnotes.en: … must be sung that he hath done magnificently, and in the whole world his mercy is to be proclaimed. With this place also agrees the beginning of the hundred and fourth psalm, where it is thus written

headnotes.la: In hoc ergo tribus constat partibus ordo dictorum. Primo dicit
headnotes.en: In this, therefore, the order of the sayings consists of three parts. First he says

headnotes.la: …ut post ministerium sanctissimae laudis grates ei dignas solvamus. Ipse enim rite invocat Deum, qui magis actu quam voce clamat ad Deum. Unde Salvator in Evangelio ad superbos et inobedientes sibi ait
headnotes.en: …ost holy praise we may pay him worthy thanks. For he duly calls upon God who cries to God more by deed than by voice. Whence the Saviour says in the Gospel to the proud and to those disobedient to him

headnotes.la: [n: (Luc. VI.)] Et alibi
headnotes.en: [n: (Luc. VI.)] And elsewhere

headnotes.la: Tertio dicit
headnotes.en: Thirdly he says

headnotes.la: …ii per apostolos, qui ex Judaeis erant, processit a fontibus Israel, melius autem est, ut Sion, id est speculam in sublimibus collocatam interpretemur Ecclesiam, de qua et quinquagesimus psalmus canit
headnotes.en: …gh the apostles who were of the Jews, from the fountains of Israel. But it is better that we interpret Sion, that is, a watchtower placed on high, as the Church, of which the fiftieth psalm also sings

headnotes.la: …chiae nomine praenotatur, quod aliqui interpretum scripturam, alii orationem nominant, videtur mihi melius gratiarum actionis vocabulo praenotari. Sic enim scriptum est in propheta [n: (Isa. XXXVIII)]
headnotes.en: …e name of Hezekiah, which some of the interpreters call a writing and others a prayer, seems to me better entitled by the word "thanksgiving." For thus it is written in the prophet [n: (Isa. XXXVIII)]

headnotes.la: Septuaginta vero ita posuerunt
headnotes.en: But the Seventy set it down thus

headnotes.la: Narrat quid tempore prementis angustiae imminentisque languoris tacitus cogitarit
headnotes.en: He tells what he had silently thought in the time of the pressing anguish and the impending sickness

headnotes.la: sive, ut alii interpretati sunt, in infirmitate et silentio dierum meorum, sive in sanguine dierum meorum, quando meus cruor meusque spectabatur interitus. Itaque in desperatione dixi
headnotes.en: — or, as others have translated, in the infirmity and silence of my days, or in the blood of my days, when my own gore and my own destruction were being looked upon. And so in despair I said

headnotes.la: Non me putans ultra esse victurum, dixi,
headnotes.en: Not thinking that I should live any longer, I said,

headnotes.la: Pro Domino et Deo hic in Hebraico ponitur, Ia, quod in extrema syllaba alleluia sonat, pro quo Septuaginta transtulerunt,
headnotes.en: For "Lord" and "God" there is here set in the Hebrew *Ia*, which sounds in the last syllable of *alleluia*; for which the Seventy translated,

headnotes.la: de qua et in alio loco scriptum est
headnotes.en: ; concerning which it is also written in another place

headnotes.la: et rursum
headnotes.en: and again

headnotes.la: Regio ergo sanctorum ipsa est, quae appellatur lux viventium
headnotes.en: That, therefore, is the region of the saints which is called the light of the living

headnotes.la: … dissolvatur, ne in telae similitudinem in ipso lucis exordio praecidatur, et nequaquam de semine ejus Christus oriatur. Quod autem corpus nostrum appelletur tabernaculum, et Apostolus instruit dicens
headnotes.en: …e likeness of a web it should be cut off at the very beginning of the light, and lest Christ should by no means arise from his seed. But that our body is called a tent, the Apostle too teaches, saying

headnotes.la: Vita ergo humana non Parcarum filis secundum gentilium fabulas orditur, sed dispositione Dei ordinatur. Unde Job ad Dominum ait
headnotes.en: Human life, therefore, is not begun upon the threads of the Fates, according to the fables of the heathen, but is ordered by the disposition of God. Whence Job says to the Lord

headnotes.la: Quod sic juxta aliam editionem legitur
headnotes.en: Which according to the other edition is read thus

headnotes.la: … Deo solo, qui poterat subvenire, elevatis in altum oculis, auxilium praestolabar, dicebamque ad eum: Plus patior, quam mea poscunt merita; sed et si quid erravi, convertar ad melius, tu sponde pro me
headnotes.en: …waited help from God alone, who was able to succour, and I said to him: I suffer more than my deserts demand; but even if I have erred in anything, I will turn to what is better; be thou surety for me

headnotes.la: …ias reputare se dicit omnes annos regni sui, et praeteritae, ut putabat, beatitudinis in praesenti amaritudine: et quia jam securus est, nec patitur quae refert de humano statu, philosophatur et dicit
headnotes.en: …his past blessedness, as he thought it, in his present bitterness; and because he is now safe, and does not suffer the things which he relates concerning the human condition, he philosophizes and says

headnotes.la: …ecisti, inquit, post tergum omnia peccata mea, ne illa tristis aspicerem, sed tuam misericordiam contemplarer: infernus enim et mors non confitebuntur neque laudabunt te, juxta illud quod scriptum est
headnotes.en: …says, behind thy back all my sins, that I might not look upon them in sadness, but might contemplate thy mercy; for hell and death shall not confess nor praise thee, according to that which is written

headnotes.la: Confessioque quae in hoc loco non pro poenitentia, sed pro gloria et laude accipitur, sicut et in Evangelio legimus
headnotes.en: And confession, which in this place is taken not for penance but for glory and praise, as we read also in the Gospel

headnotes.la: … legimus, non exspectabunt, qui descendunt in lacum, misericordiam tuam; maxime, cum Salvator ad infernum descenderit, ut vinctos de inferis liberaret. Pro lacu manifestius iidem inferos transtulerunt
headnotes.en: …ll not look for thy mercy — especially since the Saviour descended to hell, that he might free the bound from the powers below. For "pit" the same translators rendered more plainly "the powers below."

headnotes.la: Pater filiis notam faciet veritatem tuam. Hoc significat, quod et in Deuteronomio dicitur
headnotes.en: The father shall make thy truth known to his children. This signifies what is also said in Deuteronomy

headnotes.la: Non enim invenitur orare in hoc cantico, nisi per duo verba tantum, ut dicit
headnotes.en: For she is not found to pray in this canticle except by two phrases only, when she says

headnotes.en: and the other,

headnotes.en: But the Apostle says

headnotes.la: …in divino versatur officio, omnia gesta ejus, dictaque pro oratione reputantur; quia justus cum sine intermissione, quae justa sunt, agit, per hoc sine intermissione justus orabit. Et in Psalmis dicit
headnotes.en: …ll his deeds and sayings are reckoned for prayer; because when the just man does without ceasing the things that are just, by this he will pray without ceasing as a just man. And in the Psalms he says

headnotes.la: … elevante manus, vincebat Israel, dimittente vero, vincebat Amalech; quia donec famulus Dei elevat actus suos ad Dominum, vincit plebs Dei, cum autem dimiserit actus suos, vincit Amalech, inimicus Dei
headnotes.en: … let them down, Amalec conquered: because so long as the servant of God lifts up his acts to the Lord, the people of God conquers; but when he has let down his acts, Amalec, the enemy of God, conquers

headnotes.la: inquit Anna,
headnotes.en: says Anna,

headnotes.la: et necessarie addidit,
headnotes.en: and she necessarily added,

headnotes.la: ut Paulus dixit
headnotes.en: as Paul said

headnotes.la: quia potest quis gaudere in carnalibus. Cum me homines laudant, non in Domino gaudeo, sed gaudeo in vanitate: hinc compungar propter verbum Dei, cum dicit
headnotes.en: because one can rejoice in carnal things. When men praise me, I do not rejoice in the Lord, but I rejoice in vanity: hence let me be pricked to the heart because of the word of God, when it says

headnotes.la: Dicat ergo Anna, quae interpretatur gratia, Ecclesia videlicet Christi, civitas regis magni, gratia plena, prole fecunda, dicat, quod tanto ante de se prophetatum per os hujus piae matris agnoscit
headnotes.en: … the Church of Christ, the city of the great king, full of grace, fruitful in offspring, let her say that she recognizes what was prophesied of her so long before through the mouth of this holy mother

headnotes.la: Vere exsultavit cor, quia in Domino, et vere exaltatum cornu, quia non ex se, sed in Domino Deo suo exaltatum est. Et in alio loco dicit
headnotes.en: Truly the heart rejoiced, because in the Lord; and truly the horn is exalted, because not of itself, but in the Lord its God is it exalted. And in another place he says

headnotes.la: Salutaris iste Dominus est Christus Jesus, quem Simon, sicut in Evangelio legitur [n: (Luc. II)], senex amplectens parvum, agnoscens magnum
headnotes.en: That salvation is the Lord Christ Jesus, whom Simon, as is read in the Gospel [n: (Luc. II)], an old man embracing the little one, recognizing the great one, [said]

headnotes.la: Si laetatus fuero in salutari Domini, tunc dilatatum est os meum, per meditationem utique verbi Dei ad elevationem cordis veniemus. Unde Apostolus dicit
headnotes.en: If I shall have rejoiced in the salvation of the Lord, then is my mouth enlarged; by the meditation of the word of God we shall assuredly come to the lifting up of the heart. Whence the Apostle says

headnotes.la: …er te, Domine, quia nemo fit, nisi abs te, etsi sunt, qui dicuntur dii multi, et domini multi, nullus tamen eorum naturaliter est id quod Deus est, quia ipse solus est, qui dixit ad Moysen servum suum
headnotes.en: … one becomes so save from thee; and although there are those who are called many gods and many lords, yet none of them is by nature that which God is, because he alone is who said to Moses his servant

headnotes.la: Et Salomon dicit
headnotes.en: And Solomon says

headnotes.la: Et alibi
headnotes.en: And elsewhere

headnotes.la: Hoc est, magniloquium non exeat de ore vestro
headnotes.en: That is, let no great-speaking go forth out of your mouth

headnotes.la: dicit Apostolus [n: (Ephes. IV)],
headnotes.en: says the Apostle [n: (Ephes. IV)],

headnotes.la: …m pertinentibus, de sua virtute praesumentibus, in se, non in Domino gloriantibus, ex quibus sunt etiam carnales Israelitae terrenae Jerusalem, cives terrigenae, qui, ut dicit Apostolus [n: (Rom. X)],
headnotes.en: …me upon their own strength, glorying in themselves and not in the Lord; among whom are also the carnal Israelites of the earthly Jerusalem, earth-born citizens, who, as the Apostle says [n: (Rom. X)],

headnotes.la: id est, quam dat homini Deus, qui solus est justus atque justificans,
headnotes.en: that is, that which God gives to man, who alone is just and justifying,

headnotes.la: id est, velut a se sibi paratam, non ab illo impartitam,
headnotes.en: that is, as though prepared for themselves by themselves, not imparted by him,

headnotes.la: …ne Dei dono atque adjutorio humana sufficientia divina possint implere mandata, et infirmi accincti sunt robore, qui tantum in Dei pietate confidunt, et ab illo solatia quaerunt, dicentes cum Propheta
headnotes.en: …'s gift and help human sufficiency can fulfil the divine commandments; and the weak are girded with strength, who trust only in the mercy of God and seek consolations from him, saying with the Prophet

headnotes.la: …ersa Ecclesiae significata protectio, propter quod Joannes apostolus ad septem scribit Ecclesias, eo modo se ostendens ad unius plenitudinem scribere: et in Proverbiis Salomonis hoc antea praefigurans
headnotes.en: …ch is signified — on account of which John the apostle writes to seven Churches, showing in that manner that he writes to the fulness of one: and prefiguring this beforehand in the Proverbs of Solomon

headnotes.la: Quibus enim dicit Apostolus
headnotes.en: For those to whom the Apostle says

headnotes.la: salubriter mortificantur utique a Domino: quibus adjungit,
headnotes.en: are assuredly killed wholesomely by the Lord; to whom he adds,

headnotes.la: …Nam qui proprio filio non pepercit, sed pro nobis omnibus tradidit eum, iste modo utique mortificat, et quia resuscitavit a mortuis, eumdem rursus vivificavit. Et quia in prophetia vox ejus agnoscitur
headnotes.en: …wn Son, but delivered him up for us all, he assuredly in this manner killeth; and because he raised him from the dead, he again made the same alive. And because in the prophecy his voice is recognized

headnotes.la: Utique superbos humiliat et humiles exaltat; quod enim alibi legitur
headnotes.en: Assuredly he humbleth the proud and exalteth the humble; for that which is read elsewhere

headnotes.la: Inops quippe idem qui pauper; stercus vero, unde erectus est, rectissime intelliguntur persecutores Judaei: in quorum numero, cum se dixisset Apostolus Ecclesiam persecutum
headnotes.en: …e as the needy; but the dunghill, out of which he was lifted up, are most rightly understood to be the persecuting Jews: among whose number, when the Apostle had said that he had persecuted the Church

headnotes.la: Quibus ait
headnotes.en: To whom he says

headnotes.la: et sedem gloriae haereditatem dans eis
headnotes.en: and giving them the seat of glory as an inheritance

headnotes.la: Quia ipse dominatur a mari usque ad mare, et a flumine usque ad terminos orbis terrae [n: (Psal. LXXI)]
headnotes.en: Because he himself hath dominion from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the world of the earth [n: (Psal. LXXI)]

headnotes.la: …judicabit extremum terrae, quia justus est, prorsus ordinem tenuit confessionis fidelium haec prophetissa, ascendit enim in coelum Dominus Christus, et inde venturus est ad judicandum vivos et mortuos
headnotes.en: …th, because he is just. This prophetess held throughout the order of the confession of the faithful; for the Lord Christ ascended into heaven, and thence he is to come to judge the living and the dead

headnotes.la: sicut dicit Apostolus [n: (Ephes. IV)],
headnotes.en: as the Apostle says [n: (Ephes. IV)],

headnotes.la: Ac si diceretur Dominus judicabit extrema hominis: quoniam non judicabuntur, quae in melius, vel in deterius medio tempore commutantur, sed in quibus extremis inventus fuerat qui judicabitur
headnotes.en: … last things of a man: since those things will not be judged which are changed in the meantime for the better or for the worse, but the last state in which he shall have been found who is to be judged

headnotes.la: …tu ergo si mare Rubrum transieris, si Aegyptios submergi videris, et exstingui Pharaonem, atque in abyssi profundum praecipitari, potes hymnum cantare Deo, potes vocem gratulationis emittere et dicere
headnotes.en: …if thou shalt have seen the Egyptians drowned, and Pharaoh extinguished and hurled headlong into the depth of the abyss, thou canst sing a hymn to God, thou canst utter a voice of thanksgiving and say

headnotes.la: …s haec dicis, si habueris tympanum in manu tua, id est, si carnem tuam crucifixeris cum vitiis et concupiscentiis, et si mortificaveris membra tua, quae sunt supra terram, et tamen videamus quid dicit
headnotes.en: …l in thy hand, that is, if thou shalt have crucified thy flesh with its vices and concupiscences, and if thou shalt have mortified thy members which are upon the earth. And yet let us see what he says

headnotes.la: …am Dominus meus Jesus Christus, cum carnem ex Virgine pro salute nostra suscepit, glorificatus est quidem, quia venit quaerere quod perierat, non tamen gloriose glorificatus est, dicitur enim de ipso,
headnotes.en: …d Jesus Christ, when he took flesh from the Virgin for our salvation, was indeed glorified, because he came to seek that which had perished, yet he was not gloriously glorified; for it is said of him,

headnotes.la: et cum ad crucem venit et pertulit mortem; sed, ut ita dicam, humiliter, non gloriose glorificatus est. Verum quia
headnotes.en: and when he came to the cross and endured death — but, so to speak, humbly, not gloriously, was he glorified. But because

headnotes.la: …uuntur equi sunt, et ut ita dicam, omnes, qui in carne nati sunt, figuraliter equi sunt: sed qui habent ascensores suos, sunt equi, quos Dominus ascendit, et circumeunt omnem terram, de quibus dicitur
headnotes.en: …, so to speak, all who are born in the flesh are figuratively horses. But those which have their own riders are the horses which the Lord mounts, and they go about the whole earth, of which it is said

headnotes.la: Alia autem editio habet
headnotes.en: But another edition has

headnotes.la: Hic ergo et meus est Deus et Patris mei. Pater noster, qui nos fecit et genuit, Christus est. Et ipse dicit
headnotes.en: He, therefore, is both my God and my Father's. Our Father, who made us and begot us, is Christ. And he himself says

headnotes.la: Vel juxta aliam editionem
headnotes.en: Or according to another edition

headnotes.la: Simul ergo praelati et subditi currus, equites et pedites, et omnis exercitus Pharaonis submersi sunt in Rubro mari, de quo scriptum est,
headnotes.en: Together, therefore, prelates and subjects, chariots, horsemen and footmen, and the whole army of Pharaoh were drowned in the Red Sea, of which it is written,

headnotes.la: …ntati ejus obtemperes, si legem ejus sequaris, ipsa tibi elementa etiam contra sui naturam servire compellit. Apostolus ergo, quid significet transitus filiorum Israel per mare Rubrum, ostendit dicens
headnotes.en: …thou follow his law, he compels the very elements to serve thee even against their own nature. The Apostle, then, shows what the passage of the children of Israel through the Red Sea signifies, saying

headnotes.la: Abyssi utique illi de quibus in Job, ubi de Leviathan narratur, scriptum est
headnotes.en: Those depths, assuredly, of which it is written in Job, where it is told of Leviathan

headnotes.la: Quae est ista dextera, nisi illa de qua in psalmo scriptum est
headnotes.en: What is that right hand, save that of which it is written in the psalm

headnotes.la: … aliam editionem, glorificata est, quando antiquum hostem et inimicum verum per crucis mysterium confregit atque interfecit, et per mortem destruxit eum, qui habebat mortis imperium, id est, diabolum,
headnotes.en: … glorified in strength, when through the mystery of the cross it shattered and slew the ancient foe and the true enemy, and through death destroyed him who had the empire of death, that is, the devil,

headnotes.la: Ecce jam quinto commemoratur spiritus Dei, ut in hoc numero accipiamus et quod dictum est
headnotes.en: Behold, now for the fifth time the spirit of God is commemorated, so that in this number we may take also what was said

headnotes.la: Primo, ubi scriptum est
headnotes.en: First, where it is written

headnotes.en: Secondly, where it is said

headnotes.en: Fourthly, where the enchanters of the Egyptians say

headnotes.en: Fifthly, in this canticle

headnotes.la: …Dei dissimiliter appellari, cum sit unus atque idem, ille duntaxat, qui etiam sanctus Spiritus in unitate Trinitatis accipitur. Proinde non arbitror alium, quam eumdem significari, ubi dicit Apostolus
headnotes.en: …hough he is one and the same, that one at least who is also received as the Holy Spirit in the unity of the Trinity. Accordingly I judge that no other than the same is signified where the Apostle says

headnotes.la: … perducerentur ad gratiam, quae est in fide Jesu Christi. De hoc autem spiritu adoptionis et gratiae, id est, de hoc opere spiritus Dei, quo impertitur gratia et regeneratio in vitam aeternam, dicitur
headnotes.en: …hich is in the faith of Jesus Christ. But of this spirit of adoption and of grace, that is, of this work of the spirit of God by which grace and regeneration unto eternal life are imparted, it is said

headnotes.la: cum supra diceretur,
headnotes.en: whereas above it was said,

headnotes.la: …ine adjutorio gratiae. Demersi sunt, inquit, tanquam plumbum in aquam validissimam; peccatores graves sunt, denique et iniquitas super talentum plumbi sedere monstratur, sicut Zacharias propheta dicit
headnotes.en: …y, without the help of grace. They were sunk, he says, like lead in the mightiest water; sinners are heavy, and indeed iniquity too is shown to sit upon a talent of lead, as Zachariah the prophet says

headnotes.la: … et discipulus ejus Petrus, licet paululum trepidaverit: non enim tantus erat et talis, qui nihil omnino de specie plumbi in se haberet admistum. Habuit, licet parum, propter quod dicit ad eum Dominus
headnotes.en: …ough he trembled a little: for he was not so great and such a one as to have nothing at all of the nature of lead mingled in himself. He had it, though little, on account of which the Lord says to him

headnotes.la: …qui plus illuc plumbi detulerit, plus exuritur, ut amplius decoquatur, ut si parum aliquid auri purgati tamen resideat; quod si aliquis illuc totus plumbeus venerit, fiet de illo hoc quod scriptum est
headnotes.en: …burned more, that he may be melted down further, so that at least some little of purified gold may nevertheless remain; but if anyone comes thither wholly leaden, there will befall him what is written

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: Quod dicit
headnotes.en: As to what he says,

headnotes.la: … comparat Deum, nec daemonibus, qui sibi falso deorum sive fortium nomen usurpant; sed deos illos dicit, qui per generationem et participationem Dei appellantur dii, de quibus et alibi Scriptura dicit
headnotes.en: … demons, who falsely usurp to themselves the name of gods or of the strong; but he calls those gods who by generation and by participation of God are called gods, of whom Scripture also says elsewhere

headnotes.en: …lect. Whence through the Psalmist a punishment to come is foretold to the head of all the wicked together with the whole body, when, the several kinds of vices having been reckoned up, it is subjoined

headnotes.en: …, long enduring them, lest the nations bordering on them should blaspheme his name and his power. Whence Moses also says to the Lord, who was indignant for the sin of Israel and willed to destroy them

headnotes.la: … propter magnam patientiam suam et longanimitatem sustinet nolens perire quemquam, sed omnes salvos fieri et ad agnitionem veritatis pervenire, juxta illud Pauli apostoli, quod ad Romanos scribens ait
headnotes.en: …e and long-suffering, willing that no one perish, but that all be made safe and come to the acknowledging of the truth, according to that word of Paul the apostle which, writing to the Romans, he says

headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …infernalium poenarum aeternum effugiant tormentum, et quoniam disciplinabiliter vivere negligunt, tribulationem et angustiam in futuro sustinebunt, juxta illud, quod de eis scriptum est [n: (Prov. I)]
headnotes.en: …t of the infernal punishments; and since they neglect to live under discipline, they shall endure tribulation and anguish in the time to come, according to that which is written of them [n: (Prov. I)]

headnotes.en: …f our own, approve. Whence it is often read that the Jews, being delivered to their enemies, were deservedly rebuked by them for their unfaithfulness and injustice, as Jeremiah says in his lamentation

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …Scripturis sacris synagoga vel Hierusalem Sodomae et Gomorrhae comparantur, quia sicut illae male abusi sunt donis Dei; sic et istae beneficiis Dei semper exstiterunt ingrati. Unde Isaias de illis ait
headnotes.en: …or Jerusalem are compared to Sodom and Gomorrha, because as those abused the gifts of God wickedly, so these too always showed themselves ungrateful for the benefits of God. Whence Isaias says of them

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …inem et venenum in se occultant, quatenus incautos improvise laedant, sic et Judaei atque haeretici malitiam suam dolo et fraudibus velant, quatenus imprudentes facilius exstinguant. Bene ergo dicitur
headnotes.en: …n themselves, that they may wound the unwary unawares, so also Jews and heretics veil their malice with guile and frauds, that they may the more easily destroy the imprudent. Well therefore is it said

headnotes.la: quia haereticorum error quemcunque invaserit, nisi se inde liberaverit, sine dubio in aeternum perimit. Quod autem juxta aliam editionem legitur
headnotes.en: because whomsoever the error of heretics has invaded, unless he free himself therefrom, it without doubt destroys him for ever. But that which is read according to the other edition,

headnotes.la: Certa sunt apud Dominum et tempus et modus vindictae, quo peccatores, si se a peccatis non correxerint, torquendi sunt. Sed quia multae miserationes ejus sunt,
headnotes.en: Both the time and the manner of the vengeance by which sinners, if they do not correct themselves from their sins, are to be tormented, are certain with the Lord. But because his mercies are many,

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …diuturnum esse potest, quod aliquando finitur. Quidquid enim temporale est, ut est hominis aetas, cursus praesentis vitae, si ad aeternitatem comparatur, parvum fit in ejus comparatione, ideo dicitur,
headnotes.en: …t some time comes to an end. For whatever is temporal — as is the age of man, the course of the present life — if it be compared to eternity, becomes small in comparison with it. Therefore it is said,

headnotes.la: quia cito finiuntur temporalia, et parata iniquis adveniunt tormenta, juxta id, quod scriptum est
headnotes.en: because temporal things are quickly ended, and the torments prepared come upon the wicked, according to that which is written

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: Judicabit ergo Dominus populum suum, quando electos suos a reprobis secernit, nam aliquando judicare pro discernere; aliquando vero pro damnare accipitur, unde in psalmo Propheta ad Dominum dixit
headnotes.en: …ll judge his people when he separates his elect from the reprobate; for sometimes "to judge" is taken for "to discern," but sometimes for "to condemn." Whence in the psalm the Prophet said to the Lord

headnotes.la: Hic judicare pro discretione ponitur; alibi autem idem propheta ad Dominum clamans ait
headnotes.en: Here "to judge" is set for discernment; but elsewhere the same prophet, crying to the Lord, says

headnotes.la: …t, ut damnationem certam cum diabolo et angelis ejus in inferno recipiant, et ibunt hi in supplicium aeternum: justi autem in vitam aeternam, tuncque perfecte erit, quod in praedicto versu subsequitur
headnotes.en: …th the devil and his angels in hell; and these shall go into everlasting punishment, but the just into life everlasting. And then shall that be perfectly fulfilled which follows in the aforesaid verse

headnotes.la: …ymice dictum est, ubi per id quod efficitur, id quod efficit demonstratur, nam Dominus juxta naturam semper laetus et tranquillus est, nec unquam in tristitiae moerorem commutatur, de quo scriptum est
headnotes.en: … where by that which is effected is shown that which effects; for the Lord according to his nature is always glad and tranquil, nor is he ever changed into the sorrow of sadness; of whom it is written

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …m daemonum traditi ultra non praevalebunt, residuique consumpti sunt, quia ab hac vita exeuntes, non habebunt ulterius potestatem atque facultatem aliquid faciendi. Idcirco in Ecclesiaste scriptum est
headnotes.en: …no longer prevail. And the remnant have been consumed, because, departing out of this life, they shall no longer have the power and the means of doing anything. Therefore it is written in Ecclesiastes

headnotes.la: Quod autem subjungitur
headnotes.en: But that which is subjoined

headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …ndo enim carnem percutit, et mentis duritia in suo pavore tabescit, vulnerando ergo ad salutem revocat, cum electos suos affligit exterius, et interius vivificat. Recte ergo per Moysen loquitur dicens
headnotes.en: …wastes away in its own dread. By wounding, therefore, he calls back to salvation, when he afflicts his elect outwardly and quickens them inwardly. Rightly therefore does he speak through Moses, saying

headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …re, ut fulgur gladium Dei, est, repentinam vindictam in hostibus exercere: et arripere judicium manui divinae est, per justam retributionem singulis secundum propria merita reddere, sicut scriptum est
headnotes.en: …e lightning is to exercise sudden vengeance upon his enemies; and for the divine hand to lay hold on judgment is to render to each one by just retribution according to his own merits, as it is written

headnotes.la: Ad hoc, quod dicit, de cruore inimicorum subauditur illud, quod praemissum est
headnotes.en: To this which he says, from the blood of the enemies, there is understood that which went before

headnotes.la: …nt, possunt et capita iniquorum magistri accipi errantium, in quos ultio novissima redundat, quia qui fuerunt causa peccatorum, sentient damna in retributione poenarum. Unde in Apocalypsi scriptum est
headnotes.en: …sters of them that err, upon whom the final vengeance overflows, because they who were the cause of sins shall feel the losses in the retribution of punishments. Whence it is written in the Apocalypse

headnotes.la: hoc est, processit ultio tormentorum usque ad rectores populorum, usque enim ad diabolum et ejus angelos novissimo certamine exiit ultio sanguinis sanctorum effusi, sicut scriptum est
headnotes.en: … of torments went forth even to the rulers of the peoples; for the vengeance for the blood of the saints that was shed went forth in the last contest even to the devil and his angels, as it is written

headnotes.la: …r. Nam in Epistola, quae ad Hebraeos ab ipso scripta est, nec non et in illa quae ad Romanos similiter ab eo directa est, inde testimonia assumpsisse invenitur. Denique ad Hebraeos scribens sic infert
headnotes.en: …ritten by him to the Hebrews, and also in that which was likewise directed by him to the Romans, he is found to have taken testimonies thence. Accordingly, writing to the Hebrews, he brings it in thus

headnotes.la: Ad Romanos vero de gentium convocatione et satietate Judaicae plebis disputans sic ait
headnotes.en: But to the Romans, disputing concerning the calling of the Gentiles and the fullness of the Jewish people, he says thus

headnotes.la: Gentes autem super misericordia honorare Deum, sicut scriptum est
headnotes.en: But that the Gentiles are to honour God for his mercy, as it is written

headnotes.la: Et iterum dicit
headnotes.en: And again he says

headnotes.la: …ebraica veritate est, nec non et illam quae ex LXX interpretibus, aequaliter probaverunt, cum ex utraque testimonia sumpserunt. Illud vero, quod ad supernam creaturam quasi exhortando loquitur dicens,
headnotes.en: …on which is from the Hebrew verity and that which is from the LXX interpreters, since they took testimonies from both. But that which he speaks to the supernal creature as though exhorting it, saying,

headnotes.la: …damnantur, coelestes et terrestres creaturae simul in laudem sui coadunantur Conditoris, et regem Christum super omnia regnantem atque dominantem adorant et venerantur in aeternum. Quod autem sequitur
headnotes.en: …ly and the earthly creatures are gathered together alike into the praise of their Founder, and adore and venerate Christ the king, reigning and ruling over all things, for ever. But that which follows

headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …d vident laudabunt, quia praemium placet, quod habebunt, et impii in poenis constituti, licet sero, pro malo quod gesserunt poenitebunt, cum viderint gloriam sanctorum clarescere, quam non speraverunt
headnotes.en: …is pleasing; and the impious, set in punishments, shall repent, though late, of the evil which they wrought, when they shall have seen the glory of the saints grow bright, which they had not hoped for

headnotes.la: Alia editio
headnotes.en: Another edition

headnotes.la: …ue laudabilis exstat, ita et mysterii ejus sensus spiritalis singulis speciebus convenienter aptetur. Dicit enim David juxta finem centesimi et secundi Psalmi, quem ad benedicendum Deum composuit, ita
headnotes.en: … also the spiritual sense of its mystery should be fittingly adapted to each several kind. For David says, near the end of the hundred and second Psalm, which he composed for the blessing of God, thus

headnotes.la: …uum benedicere Creatorem, et in omni loco dominationis ejus, quia sicut nulla creatura a laudibus Domini jubetur excipi, ita nec locus quisquam relinquitur, qui tali munere segregetur. Nam cum dicitur
headnotes.en: …of his dominion, because just as no creature is bidden to be excepted from the praises of the Lord, so neither is any place left over that should be set apart from such an office. For when it is said,

headnotes.la: Aquas vero super coelos esse Genesis refert; ait enim
headnotes.en: That there are waters above the heavens Genesis relates; for it says

headnotes.la: De virtutibus Dei dicitur in psalmo
headnotes.en: Of the powers of God it is said in the psalm

headnotes.la: De quo et Psalmista dicit
headnotes.en: Of which the Psalmist also says

headnotes.la: Hoc est quod in Psalterio novissime scriptum
headnotes.en: This is what is written last in the Psalter

headnotes.la: …persecutionis exprimit. Sed haec benedicunt Dominum, quando homines faciunt benedicere Creatorem suum, quia sancti viri et in prosperis et in adversis semper laudant Dominum. Unde Apostolus exhortatur
headnotes.en: …igne prints *aestas*, "summer"] But these bless the Lord when they make men bless their Creator, because holy men both in prosperity and in adversity always praise the Lord. Whence the Apostle exhorts

headnotes.la: …oraliter vivunt ad benedicendum Deum, debitores fiunt, quia creator omnium, sic temperat electis suis praesentia, ut ipsi perpetualiter praeconia non taceant divina, unde Paulus ait [n: (II Cor. XII)]
headnotes.en: …the blessing of God; because the creator of all things so tempers things present for his elect that they themselves may never be silent of the divine proclamations. Whence Paul says [n: (II Cor. XII)]

headnotes.la: Et item: [n: (II Cor. IV)]
headnotes.en: And again [n: (II Cor. IV)]

headnotes.la: « Benedicite, gelu et frigus, Dominum. Benedicite, glacies et nives, Dominum
headnotes.en: « Bless ye the Lord, O frost and cold. Bless ye the Lord, O ice and snows

headnotes.la: Et in psalmo
headnotes.en: And in the psalm

headnotes.la: Quid ergo per nubes, nisi Evangelii praedicatores, et quid per fulgura, nisi coruscationes miraculorum nobis demonstrantur? de quibus per Psalmistam dicitur
headnotes.en: What, then, is shown us by the clouds but the preachers of the Gospel, and what by the lightnings but the flashings of miracles? Of which it is said through the Psalmist

headnotes.la: Hic ergo terra sanctam Ecclesiam significat, de qua in Psalmo scriptum est
headnotes.en: [var: Vulg. *laudet et superexaltet*, "let it praise and exalt him"] Here, then, the earth signifies the holy Church, of which it is written in the Psalm

headnotes.la: Hinc etiam Psalmista, ubi omnes creaturas ad laudandum Dominum provocat, inter caetera ait
headnotes.en: Hence also the Psalmist, where he calls forth all creatures to praise the Lord, says among the rest

headnotes.la: …quatuor flumina procedebant, hoc est, quatuor Evangelia de fonte salutaris procedentia ad irrigationem generis humani. Item fons Spiritus sancti gratiam designat in eo, quod Dominus dicit in Evangelio
headnotes.en: …t is, the four Gospels proceeding from the fountain of salvation for the watering of the human race. Again, a fountain designates the grace of the Holy Spirit in that which the Lord says in the Gospel

headnotes.la: Baptismi vero sacramentum ostendit illud Zachariae, quo ait
headnotes.en: [var: Vulg. *fons aquae salientis*, without *vivae*, "living"] But the sacrament of baptism is shown by that of Zacharias, where he says

headnotes.la: …scamur in Christo et non aqua baptismatis nostra nobis peccata donentur. Sed hic fontes possumus testimonia sacrarum Scripturarum per ora praedicatorum prolata intelligere. Unde in psalmo scriptum est
headnotes.en: …en us by the water of baptism. But here we can understand by the fountains the testimonies of the sacred Scriptures brought forth through the mouths of the preachers. Whence it is written in the psalm

headnotes.la: Quando dicit maria, generaliter omnes aquarum collectiones, sive salsae sint, sive dulces simul comprehendit juxta illud, quod scriptum est
headnotes.en: When he says "seas," he generally comprehends together all gatherings of waters, whether they be salt or fresh, according to that which is written

headnotes.la: a quibus flumina procedunt, ut est illud
headnotes.en: from which the rivers proceed, as is that saying

headnotes.la: …dine non impletur. Benedicere ergo jubentur homines Dominum, hoc est, auctorem suum cognoscere, illumque fide et bonis operibus colere, quia ab ipso creati sunt, et ad ejus judicium omnes revertuntur,
headnotes.en: …de. Men are bidden, therefore, to bless the Lord — that is, to acknowledge their author, and to worship him by faith and by good works, because they were created by him and all return to his judgment,

headnotes.la: …ad custodiam hominum in mundum a Deo mittuntur, ut eorum curam gerant, et contra spiritales nequitias illos defendant, quia aequum est ut omnes praelati simul et subditi omnium dominatorem benedicant,
headnotes.en: …he keeping of men, that they may have care of them and defend them against the spiritual wickednesses; because it is right that all prelates together with their subjects should bless the ruler of all,

headnotes.la: Humilitatem cordis habere et praesens versiculus docet, et illud, quod in Evangelio legitur
headnotes.en: That we should have humility of heart both this present little verse teaches, and that which is read in the Gospel

headnotes.la: …frui desiderant in regno coelesti. Hoc autem quod sequitur in hoc Cantico ante praelatum est in libro prophetico, ubi priusquam provocarentur opera Domini ad benedicendum Dominum, ita scriptum legitur
headnotes.en: … in the heavenly kingdom. But that which follows in this Canticle was set before in the prophetic book, where, before the works of the Lord were called forth to bless the Lord, it is read written thus

headnotes.la: …us adventu manifeste sunt locuti; verum ipse pater Adam, Abel et Enoch, et caeteri Patrum factis quique suis ejus dispensationi testimonium reddunt. Unde Dominus ipse Judaeorum duritiam redarguens ait
headnotes.en: …ng; but father Adam himself, and Abel and Enoch, and the rest of the Fathers each by his own deeds give testimony to his dispensation. Whence the Lord himself, reproving the hardness of the Jews, says

headnotes.la: Jungendum est a superiori versiculo, Erexit nobis, id est, erexit nobis salutem ex inimicis nostris, cum enim primo breviter praemisisset
headnotes.en: It is to be joined with the verse above, He hath raised up for us — that is, he hath raised up for us salvation from our enemies; for when he had first briefly premised,

headnotes.la: continuo quasi apertius quid erexit explanans
headnotes.en: he immediately explains, as it were more openly, what he raised up

headnotes.la: …utem qui oderunt nos, vel homines perversos, vel immundos spiritus significat, de quorum manu et interim spe salvi facti sumus, et in futuro reipsa salvandi. Quod autem in quibusdam Ecclesiis canitur,
headnotes.en: …ies either perverse men or unclean spirits, from whose hand we have both meanwhile been made safe in hope, and are in time to come to be saved in very deed. And as to what is sung in certain Churches,

headnotes.la: …licet his praecipue patriarchis de suo semine vel congregatio gentium, vel Christi est incarnatio promissa, quod Matthaeus quoque breviter intimare voluit, qui Evangelii sui principium hoc modo caepit
headnotes.en: …ly there was promised, of their seed, either the gathering of the nations or the incarnation of Christ; which Matthew too wished briefly to intimate, who began the opening of his Gospel in this manner

headnotes.la: …. Abrahae namque qui adhuc in praeputio positus propria dereliquit, Deum cognovit, fidei testimonium meruit, fides tantum gentium et sacrosanctus Ecclesiae coetus est promissus, dicente ad eum Domino,
headnotes.en: …circumcision, forsook his own goods, knew God, and deserved the testimony of faith, there was promised only the faith of the nations and the most sacred assembly of the Church, the Lord saying to him,

headnotes.la: David autem oraculo sublimiore, quod ex ipso Christus secundum carnem nasciturus esset audivit
headnotes.en: but David heard by a loftier oracle that Christ was to be born of him according to the flesh

headnotes.la: …i et erubescant, audiant mansueti et laetentur, quod Christum Dominum, quem Joannes prophetando praeibat, altissimum vocat, juxta quod Psalmista Deum hominemque perfectum in una persona collaudans ait
headnotes.en: …et the meek hear and rejoice, that he calls Christ the Lord, whom John by prophesying went before, the Most High, according to that which the Psalmist, praising God and perfect man in one person, says

headnotes.la: …e desiderans, salutis mentionem frequentat, cum cornu salutis erigendum, salutem ex inimicis futuram, scientiam salutis plebi dandam commemorat; sed ne temporalem carnalemque promitti salutem putares,
headnotes.en: … is to be raised up, that salvation from our enemies is to come, that knowledge of salvation is to be given to the people; but lest thou shouldst think a temporal and fleshly salvation to be promised,

headnotes.la: Et propheta de Domino loquens
headnotes.en: And the prophet, speaking of the Lord

headnotes.la: …ibus quippe in tenebris et umbra mortis Domino illuminare, est his qui in peccatis et ignorantiae caecitate vixerint agnitionis amorisque sui radios infundere, qualibus dicit Apostolus [n: (Ephes. V)]
headnotes.en: …rkness and the shadow of death is to pour into those who have lived in sins and in the blindness of ignorance the rays of his own knowledge and love — to such as these the Apostle says [n: (Ephes. V)]

headnotes.la: …is illuminatorisque nostri gratiae concordat; congruo sane ordine primo illuminanda corda et post opera dirigenda testatur, quia nemo, quam non ante didicerit pacem valet operari. Unde recte Psalmista
headnotes.en: …ing order indeed he testifies that hearts are first to be enlightened and afterwards works to be directed, because no one can work the peace which he has not first learned. Whence rightly the Psalmist

headnotes.la: …, nequaquam se de donis coelestibus, quasi a se haec essent, extulit; sed ut magis magisque donis esset apta divinis, in custodiam humilitatis mentis suae gressum fixit, memor Scripturae praecipientis
headnotes.en: …ts as though these were from herself; but that she might be more and more fitted for the divine gifts, she fixed the step of her mind in the keeping of humility, mindful of the Scripture which enjoins

headnotes.la: …sentio, discerno, gratulanter impendo, quia et ejusdem Jesu, id est, salutaris, spiritus meus aeterna divinitate laetatur, cujus me caro temporali conceptione laetatur; cui simile est illud Psalmistae
headnotes.en: …o end, because my spirit is glad also in the eternal divinity of the same Jesus, that is, of the saviour, whose flesh rejoices me by a temporal conception; to which is like that saying of the Psalmist

headnotes.la: Ad initium carminis respicit, ubi dictum est
headnotes.en: He looks back to the beginning of the song, where it was said,

headnotes.la: sola quippe anima illa, cui Dominus magna facere dignatur, dignis eum praeconiis magnificare, et ad consortes ejusdem voti ac propositi potest cohortando dicere
headnotes.en: : for that soul alone, to which the Lord vouchsafes to do great things, can magnify him with worthy proclamations, and can say by way of exhortation to the sharers of the same vow and purpose

headnotes.la: In brachio ergo suo Dominus per omnes saeculi generationes potentes, hoc est, superbos de sede jactantiae suae deponit, et exaltat humiles, qui non sua potentia, sed in Dei bonitate confidunt,
headnotes.en: …ughout all the generations of the world puts down the mighty — that is, the proud — from the seat of their boasting, and exalts the humble, who trust not in their own power but in the goodness of God,

headnotes.la: Pulchre Israel puerum Domini appellat, qui ab eo sit ad salvandum susceptus, obedientem videlicet et humilem, juxta Oseae dictum
headnotes.en: Beautifully he calls Israel the servant of the Lord, as one taken up by him to be saved — obedient, that is, and humble, according to the saying of Osee

headnotes.la: nam qui contemnit humiliari, non potest utique salvari, nec dicere cum Propheta
headnotes.en: for he who scorns to be humbled cannot at all be saved, nor say with the Prophet

headnotes.la: …usque populi pater fieret per fidem, juxta quod Apostolus ad Romanos plenissime disseruit. Adventus ergo Salvatoris, Abrahae et semini ejus in saecula promissus est filiis promissionis, quibus dicitur
headnotes.en: … to what the Apostle most fully set forth to the Romans. The coming, therefore, of the Saviour, promised to Abraham and to his seed for ever, is promised to the sons of the promise, to whom it is said

headnotes.la: …oc est, transiliator cupidita tum saecularium, postquam multa diu tacitus mundi mala contemplatus interna secum cordis meditatione concaluit, tandem locutus in lingua sua, et quae intus egerit promens
headnotes.en: …g in silence contemplated the many evils of the world and had grown warm within himself by the inward meditation of his heart, spoke at last in his own tongue and brought forth what he had done within

headnotes.la: Beati oculi qui vident quae Simeon vidit
headnotes.en: Blessed are the eyes that see what Simeon saw

headnotes.la: …culos profunda jam caecitate demersos, neque ulla spe adventus Dominici erectos ipse visitare pariter revelare atque illustrare dignatus est. Et bene revelatio gentium Israelis gloriae praefertur, qui
headnotes.en: … by no hope of the Lord's coming, he himself vouchsafed to visit and likewise to reveal himself to and to enlighten. And rightly is the revelation of the Gentiles set before the glory of Israel, since

headnotes.la: quomodo et Psalmista cum diceret
headnotes.en: just as the Psalmist also, when he had said,

headnotes.la: subjunxit, atque ait,
headnotes.en: subjoined and said,
